title: Determination 2014/053: two-storey commercial laboratory with accessible stairs instead of a lift, Gracefield, Lower Hutt
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004); comparative test only, not Alberta; NZ code references retained as written
code_edition: Building Code Clause D1 as cited; edition not captured on pages read

facts.text: The owner Gemini Research Ltd (applicant, acting through a designer), Hutt City Council (authority) and tenant Arotec Diagnostics Ltd are the parties; the Office for Disability Issues was included.

The proposed two-storey commercial building has a ground-floor GFA of 835 m² (laboratory and related rooms, offices, sanitary facilities) and a first-floor GFA of 567 m² (incubation, workshop, four R&D rooms, a café/lunch room, offices, boardroom and lobby).
The consent application provided for two accessible stairs to the first floor; no lift is shown.
The application was made on 17 February 2014; the Ministry did not see the consent application itself, and understood it included an accessibility report from the designer.
